notes.title: 2.0.4 update available
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 2.0.4 is out now.

While we’re keeping busy with other projects at the moment, Jar Wars holds a special place in our heart, and we took some time to make sure the game is working with the latest VR headsets. 

We tested this release with many different PC-based VR headsets, as well as with the Oculus Link on the Quest and Quest 2.

Technical note: We’ve updated the OpenVR SDK to 1.14.15
